name: Section push (page turn between sections)

source.description: 3 inspected reference films (batch-2, batch-5, 2026-11-26): a photo-led brand explainer turns chapters by pushing pages sideways, alternating light and dark sections; a SaaS promo pushes a section up.

technique: The next section arrives as a panel from one side and pushes the current page off the other side, like turning a catalogue page. Alternating light and dark sections make each push read as a new chapter.
purpose: Mark a new chapter with a page turn: the alternation of light and dark sections, not the move itself, carries the meaning.
visual_behaviour: The next section arrives as a panel from one edge and pushes the current page off the other edge at the same speed; its content fades in a quarter second after it lands.
mechanics: Incoming panel enters from the right edge while the outgoing page translates left at the same speed; 0.4-0.6 s with a fast start and soft landing (power3.out); incoming content fades in 0.2-0.3 s after the panel lands (ref-c6d0aa55f6 12.05-12.45, 28.05-28.45, 47.05-47.40 s). Vertical variant: a coloured section slides up off the frame while the next card rises from below (ref-5a2816d4db 6.95-7.35 s).
use_cases: Brand or catalogue explainers with distinct sections
failure_modes: Pushing every scene turns the film into a slideshow
Different speeds for the two panels open a gap

implementation.approach: Studio.fx.push (effect push-transition, recipe scene-push) or Studio.transition with a slide type, 0.4-0.6 s power3.out, both panels at one speed; fade the incoming content in 0.2-0.3 s after the landing. Alternate section palettes (light, dark) so each push reads as a chapter. Kept as its own technique record because effects carry no reference provenance; the knowledge here is the chapter grammar and the content delay.

provenance.observed: A dark section pushes the cream page left (12.05 and 47.05 s); a cream page pushes left (28.05 s); each in about 0.4 s.
The blue section slides up off the frame while the white product card rises from below (6.95-7.35 s).
The orange statement page pushes up off the frame in about 0.1 s onto a cream page (3.52-3.59 s). Note: Vertical variant.
A green panel pushes in from the right and moves the page off to the left in about 0.25 s (6.15-6.42 s); the composition slides off left for the close (46.18-46.32 s).
A flat lime, black or white panel pushes the card off to the left in about 0.1 s (19.19-19.32 s) and stays as the next card's background, once every 2.50 s.
A dark panel pushes in from the right with a blurred leading edge and takes the frame in about 0.13 s (8.42-8.55 s).
A blue panel slides in from the right carrying the next word (5.81-6.14 s); a red panel rises from the lower right and covers the frame in about 0.15 s (9.18-9.34 s).
